prompt: Under Texas Penal Code §49.031, what constitutes an illegal 'open container' in a motor vehicle?

options.text: Any bottle, can, or receptacle containing alcohol that is open, unsealed, or partly consumed
Exclusively an empty glass beer bottle resting on the floorboards of the backseat
Unopened, sealed cases of canned beer purchased from a licensed grocery supermarket
Any container holding non-alcoholic sparkling water with broken plastic seals
